projects.name: UrbanCart Website

tasks.title: Product catalog UI
tasks.description: Product listing, product detail screen and responsive layout.

tasks.title: Demo cart UI
tasks.description: Add and remove items, change quantities and show a visible total in the demo cart.

tasks.title: Product and cart APIs
tasks.description: Product data responses and demo cart endpoints, without payment processing.

tasks.title: Website integration and testing
tasks.description: Connect the screens to the API and verify the demo flow end to end.

projects.description: Responsive website where customers browse products, view product details and add items to a demo cart. Real payments and inventory integration are excluded from this phase.

projects.name: QuickServe Mobile App

tasks.title: Login and profile screens
tasks.description: Customer login interface and a basic profile screen.

tasks.title: Service booking screens
tasks.description: Select a service, enter request details and see a confirmation screen.

tasks.title: Booking and account APIs
tasks.description: Basic customer account handling, service requests and request status endpoints.

tasks.title: Mobile integration and testing
tasks.description: Connect the mobile UI to the API, display request status and test the whole customer flow.

projects.description: Flutter customer app for signing in, requesting a service and viewing request status. Maps, driver tracking and payments are excluded.

projects.name: HelpDeskPro AI Assistant

tasks.title: FAQ document processing
tasks.description: Prepare the supplied FAQ so the assistant can retrieve relevant content.

tasks.title: Assistant answer generation
tasks.description: Use the prepared FAQ content, connect the model and handle the response structure, declining unsupported questions.

tasks.title: Human escalation flow
tasks.description: Save unresolved questions as escalation records for human review.

tasks.title: Assistant evaluation and testing
tasks.description: Test FAQ answers, unsupported questions and the escalation path.

projects.description: Support assistant that answers questions from the supplied FAQ document and records unresolved questions for a human team. No external message sending or ticketing integration.
